answer: Every inlet aims at the dawn notch, rehearsing daily: first light crosses the same line each morning, and an honest observatory logs it - aim kept true by cheap rehearsal. Once an era, the comet crosses that line, and grand calibration fires: every inlet that saw the crossing reports, and clocks snap into agreement - one rare event witnessed from many truths beats mailed testimony. An inlet that missed the comet while claiming sightlines is exposed: logs show drift, aim was never true. Farms fabricate sightings, never matching a hundred angles. Honest agents keep the log; the comet forgets.
